text:
maya: Heads-up — candidate for backend eng (final on Fri 4/2 10:30am PT) just confirmed. Need a last-minute panel swap: Jordan can't make the 10:30 slot. Can someone cover engineering lead + scribe?

sam: I can cover lead if someone else can scribe. timezone ok for me.

tara: I can scribe. quick q: do we want the standard 10m buffer between interviews for the debrief, or extend to 15 this round? candidate has a take-home.

managers-note: people-ops-bot pinned the calendar invite: https://calendar.company/evt/abcd1234 :spiral_calendar:

anita: For scoring: do we keep system-design 50 / culture 25 / problem-solving 25 or shift given take-home? I'm worried about overweighting take-home vs live.

maya: Good call. I think we should move to 40/30/30 for this one so live interaction matters. Open to objections.

jmcc: 40/30/30 sounds fine to me. Also confirm scribe will capture one sample question to add to the eval tracker (we had a regression on async scoring last round).

tara: noted — I'll capture the sample question + short notes. Plan: join 10:20 for quick sync, scribe during debrief, post summary in #hiring-debriefs.

sam: OK I'll update the calendar: swapping jordan -> sam as lead, tara as scribe. Calendar invite command below:

```
/ical update evt/abcd1234 attendees add sam@company.com remove jordan@company.com add tara@company.com
```

maya: @people-ops-bot could you confirm recording consent is on the invite? We need candidate opt-in recorded. :eyes:

people-ops-bot: auto-reminder — recording consent checkbox is OFF on the invite. Please toggle or add the consent line to the meeting description: "We may record this interview for hiring calibration; please let us know if you prefer not to be recorded."

anita: Also small rubric clarification: for system-design, are we scoring architecture and tradeoffs separately, or combined? The scorer sheet has separate rows but people conflate them.

maya: Split them — architecture (10) + tradeoffs (10) inside the system-design bracket. I'll update the rubric doc with that explicit split and link in the invite.

jmcc: One last logistics ask — can we reserve the following 15m block after 10:30 for the candidate follow-up/cold handoff? Some PMs asked for extra time occasionally. If not, Tara can flag in summary.

sam: I set the buffer to 15m and added it to the invite. All set from my side. :thumbsup:

tara: I'll post the debrief summary in #hiring-debriefs within 1 hour after the interview and attach the scribe notes + a one-line pass/hold rec.

maya: Thanks everyone. If anything changes ping here. :sparkles:
